تتبحبحون (form IIq)
# تَتَبَحْبَحُونَ (tatabaḥbaḥūna) /ta.ta.baħ.ba.ħuː.na/: second-person masculine plural non-past active indicative of تَبَحْبَحَ (tabaḥbaḥa)
# تُتَبَحْبَحُونَ (tutabaḥbaḥūna) /tu.ta.baħ.ba.ħuː.na/: second-person masculine plural non-past passive indicative of تَبَحْبَحَ (tabaḥbaḥa)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
